intent: A hall of heroes: an avenue of colossal armoured heroes of the gods' host, each on a lifted marble plinth with spear and shield toward the processional way, under gold light gathered at their feet: a new colossal-figure assembly nobody has made, its own hero-light set piece, and avenue plans (straight, dogleg, cross, fork), edges, stances and way levels that make every seed a different place to fight through.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: colossal hero with shield over the avenue
critic.why: The best figure work in the run and real layout variety; a strong hall to fight through.

role: Main-route platform: the hero avenue is the Domain's processional spine to fight down.
notes:
# F

Keep: Keep the colossal spear-and-shield heroes and the varied avenue plans.

1. Drop the bare dead trees in the shots; they pull it toward the moor.
2. Gild the heroes more (helms, shield bosses) so they read as divine, not grey stone.
3. Add a toppled hero as a cover piece on more seeds.
